summary: Neo bolts upright in bed, screaming, then realizes he is home and that his mouth and stomach are normal, wondering if it was a dream. As he starts to take a reassuring breath, the phone rings, nearly stopping his heart and pulling him out of bed to answer it in silence. Morpheus, on the line, warns that it is tapped and must be brief, telling Neo that the Agents got to him first but underestimated his importance and would have killed him if they knew what Morpheus knows. Confused and frightened, Neo asks what is happening to him. Morpheus declares, 'You're the One, Neo,' and says that while Neo spent years looking for him, he spent most of his life looking for Neo. When Morpheus asks if he still wants to meet, Neo answers '... Yes,' and is told to go to the Adams Street bridge before the line clicks dead. Neo closes his eyes, unsure of what he has done.

what_changes.before: Waking in terror and disorientation, then briefly reassured that he is safe at home.
what_changes.after: Jolted into dread and compulsion by the ringing phone, which forces him out of bed.
what_changes.evidence: He starts to take a deep, everything-is-okay breath when -- The PHONE RINGS. It almost stops his heart.

what_changes.before: Confused about his situation, asking 'What the hell is happening to me?'
what_changes.after: Told he is 'the One' and that Morpheus has spent his life searching for him, leaving him sick and unsettled.
what_changes.evidence: You're the One, Neo. You see, you may have spent the last few years looking for me, but I've spent most of my life looking for you. Neo feels sick.

what_changes.after: Commits to meeting Morpheus, answering '... Yes,' and accepting the instruction to go to the Adams Street bridge.
what_changes.evidence: Do you still want to meet? NEO ... Yes.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus reaches Neo by a tapped line to confirm his importance and set up their meeting at the Adams Street bridge.

uncertain: Whether Neo's prior experiences (mouth, stomach, the Agents) were a dream or real.
What exactly awaits Neo at the Adams Street bridge or what 'meeting' entails.

minds.wants: To be told what is happening to him — to have the nightmare (mouth gone, stomach gone, the Agents) explained by someone who can name it, so the terror stops being shapeless.
minds.feels: Raw and destabilized: he has just woken screaming from something that felt real enough to leave his body braced, and the ringing phone converts the brief relief of 'I'm safe at home' straight into dread. When Morpheus names him 'the One,' he physically recoils ('Neo feels sick') — the thing he chased for years is now naming him, and it is too large to hold.
minds.shows: Silence first (he answers the phone 'saying nothing,' which the scene hands us as a real choice — fear has taken his voice), then a blunt, frightened demand for explanation, and finally a single, delayed '... Yes.'
minds.basis: He bolts upright screaming, checks his mouth and stomach as if to confirm they're real, then the phone 'almost stops his heart.' His only lines are 'The Agents —', 'What the hell is happening to me?', and the hesitant '... Yes,' followed by closing his eyes 'unsure of what he has done.' The text states 'Neo feels sick' outright.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is the authority who can finally explain his life and give the pursuit meaning — the answer to 'Why is this happening to me?'
believes_about.wrong_because: He is treating Morpheus's declaration ('You're the One') as revelation, not yet knowing that Morpheus's certainty is a faith project ('I've spent most of my life looking for you') that will soon require Neo to submit to a stranger's plan, a gun at his head, and the erasure of his entire known life.

believes_about.belief: That he is 'nobody' — the same line he cried on the ledge in sc-018 ('I'm nobody. I didn't do anything.').
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus is inverting exactly that self-concept, asserting Neo is important enough that the Agents would have killed him. Neo cannot yet reconcile the two, which is why the praise lands as nausea rather than relief.

minds.wants: To secure Neo's commitment to the meeting before the tapped line is traced, using the minimum words necessary — he is engineering a decision, not giving comfort.
minds.feels: Controlled urgency layered over conviction. He has been watching Neo's capture (he knows 'they got to you first') and is working against a closing window, yet he frames everything as prophecy fulfilled — his long search ending — which lets him sound calm and inevitable rather than desperate.
minds.shows: A terse, declarative voice: he announces the constraint ('This line is tapped so I must be brief'), reframes Neo's panic about the Agents into proof of Neo's importance, delivers the identity claim, and closes with a yes/no question that forces Neo to choose — then hangs up the instant he gets 'Yes.'
minds.basis: His dialogue is all directive and revelation with zero reassurance; he names the tap, interprets the Agents' visit as their mistake, states 'I've spent most of my life looking for you,' and asks 'Do you still want to meet?' — the same kind of either/or he offered on the scaffold ('I leave it to you').

believes_about.belief: That Neo is 'the One' — that the man he has hunted is finally reachable and will say yes when offered the meeting.
believes_about.wrong_because: He is reading Neo through prophecy, not through the frightened, sick, unsure person actually on the line. His confidence that Neo will comply is correct in outcome but blind to how little Neo understands or wants any of it yet — Neo agrees from vertigo, not conviction.

connects_back: The nightmare of his mouth/stomach being destroyed and the Agents — the trauma that woke him screaming — is the residue of the interrogation in sc-020 (Agent Smith's ice-blue eyes, the two-lives file) and the ledge sequence in sc-018.
His question 'What the hell is happening to me?' echoes the ledge ('Why is this happening to me? What did I do? I'm nobody.'), so the scene answers the exact despair he voiced before his capture.

Morpheus's either/or framing ('Do you still want to meet?') mirrors the scaffold choice in sc-018 ('only two ways out... I leave it to you'), continuing his method of forcing Neo to choose under pressure.
Morpheus knowing 'they got to you first' depends on the off-screen capture in sc-019 and the interrogation in sc-020 — he has been tracking Neo throughout.
sets_up: ev-004: Neo walking out into the rainy night to the Adams Street bridge, being taken at gunpoint, and submitting to the bug extraction from his stomach — the body that felt 'fine' here is exactly what must be opened.
ev-005: Neo's arrival at the Hotel Lafayette and his first direct encounter with Morpheus, the 'meeting' he just agreed to.
ev-006: Neo taking the red pill and being unplugged — the irreversible commitment his hesitant 'Yes' has already set in motion.
ev-010: Morpheus's later confirmation that Neo cannot return to the Matrix, which is the consequence Neo here accepts without understanding ('unsure of what he has done').
dramatic_function: It converts the private terror of the interrogation into a fated calling: by having an unseen, trusted voice name Neo 'the One' and extract a single 'Yes,' the scene pivots Neo from a hunted man trying to understand his life into a man who has consented — in fear and confusion — to have that life dismantled, launching the extraction and unplugging that follow.
